stem.text: Compound X has stereoisomers and forms a precipitate when warmed with Fehling's reagent.
What could be the structure of compound X?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: branched alkene (C=C) with a terminal aldehyde (CHO) group.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: alkene (C=C) with an internal ketone (C=O) group.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: branched ketone (C=O drawn above the chain) with a methyl branch.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: branched aldehyde with a methyl group on the chain and a terminal CHO group.
